global_rules.first_sentence: genuine warm reaction to their personal post
global_rules.second_sentence: optional natural bridge to self-care, glow-up, event prep, or free consultation only if supported by the actual post content
global_rules.template_usage_rule: Templates are style references only. Do not reuse their concrete nouns, scenes, body comments, or sample compliments unless those details are present in the current post.
forbidden_phrases: we can make you look younger

categories.label: Novias / Brides
categories.context: Bride posts wedding planning, dress, venue, countdown, engagement photos, bridal shower, or asks for beauty/wellness recommendations.
categories.rule: Lead with genuine celebration. Bridge to bridal glow/event prep and free consultation, not pressure or pricing.

categories.label: Postpartum / Moms
categories.context: Mom posts baby photos, self-care after pregnancy, getting back to herself, or asks for wellness recommendations.
categories.rule: Lead with empathy and congratulations. Never comment on body size, insecurity, weight, medical recovery, or mental health; only mention self-care if the post is positive and safe.

categories.rule: Only engage with positive, goal-oriented posts. Skip posts with distress, eating disorder signals, shame, extreme dieting, or negative body image.

banned_patterns.why: Agresivo, ofensivo y puede generar rechazo inmediato.

banned_patterns.bad: We can fix your body after pregnancy.
banned_patterns.why: Lenguaje sensible y prohibido; nunca comentar inseguridades corporales.

banned_patterns.bad: Cheap Botox and fillers, book now!
banned_patterns.why: Suena spam, devalúa el servicio y usa CTA agresivo.

banned_patterns.bad: Your wrinkles would look better with injectables.
banned_patterns.why: Comentario invasivo, negativo y riesgoso para la marca.
